author: CC
prose: Two ways a request's real reply can be stranded on the bus, each measured once (2026-11-05, the only two envelopes that stood on the live bus): (a) the bus bounces a request whose addressee has no receiver at that instant, request() returns the bounce as its reply because the bounce carries reply_to, and the addressee's real reply lands milliseconds later with nobody waiting (cdb9912a / 205e6256, sail->codemother, 2026-10-28 21:37:32 UTC); (b) a new bus process comes up while a request() is waiting in the old one, so the late reply lands on a process with no _abandoned record of the asker (4b36cd28 / 9c201247, constrain->tester, 2026-10-31 02:58 UTC, transit_table_ensured at 02:58:27). Each stood forever and was re-raised as mail-<to>-stood-600s at every bus restart (124x and 89x) until cc receipted them by hand.
